scope: Deterministic timing regression, not a population success estimate: CG height 20/40/80 m × heading 0/60 degrees × yaw rate 0/1 rad/s × gas 400/260 kg in a 400 kg tank; roll/pitch rates .01 rad/s, initial vertical speed −1 m/s, horizontal speed 5 m/s, clear flat ground.
landingCriterion: Unchanged driving success: stable tire support for one second, no body/hard contact. Lateral displacement alone is not a failure.
ignitionCriterion: First sampled actual upward jet force exceeding half current weight.
